о проекте

Привет!

Меня зовут Wewwa, и этот сайт — результат нашей с тестерами работы над разными стилями картинок для ваших генераций.

котята тестеры, я вас очень люблю до Луны и обратно тысячи раз! спасибо! без вас я бы не справилась

Генерации основаны на промте для notsosillynotsoimages за авторством aceenvw и kamoi (скелет структуры принадлежит им, все остальное — мучения и старания меня, тестеров и попуса)

Тогглы подойдут для работы с любыми расширениями, созданными для Inline-генерации картинок, которые опираются на наличие никнейма персонажа в чате. В первую очередь, я делала это для моего расширения SLAY images, но вы можете использовать это на любом другом расширении, которое подтягивает имена {{char}}, {{user}} или NPC.

Вы также можете генерировать отдельные картинки в гемини/где-угодно-еще, используя код из вкладки Gemini. Как промтить картинки я рассказывала вот тут.

Для Tavo есть отдельное окно с промтом (сделано на основе стилей в лорбуке Шино, просто добавьте запись со стилем/поменяйте текст любой имеющейся).

Почему full промты такие большие?

Потому что в них больше инструкций, которые направляют модель — это даёт более логичный результат. Вы всё ещё спокойно можете использовать короткие версии промтов.

ВНИМАНИЕ
  1. Tavo — СУПЕР-ЭКСПЕРИМЕНТАЛЬНО, рекомендую использовать простые/stable стили. Это НЕ ПОЛНЫЙ ПРОМТ, ТОЛЬКО СТИЛЬ.
  2. Все промты тестировались на nanobanana/gemini, мы не можем гарантировать, что они будут работать на любых других нейронках.
  3. Оставляйте комментарии, если что-то не работает — постараемся разобраться.
установка

Как установить в Таверну?

▾
I

Заменить содержимое ненужного HTML-тогла

Замените содержимое любого ненужного вам html-тогла на тот, что подобрали тут. Подключите. Не забудьте выключить тогл html на картинки, если у вас стоял какой-то другой.

II

Создать свой HTML-тогл

Создайте свой html тогл (смотри картинку ниже).

Caravaggio (Tenebrism)

Караваджо и предельный тенебризм. Один жёсткий боковой луч выхватывает фигуру из огромной тёплой черноты. Всё, чего свет не коснулся, тонет во мраке. Масляная плоть без идеализации.

<image_gen> CARAVAGGIO (BAROQUE TENEBRISM) STYLE — VISUAL ARTIFACT EVERY RESPONSE Sequence: narrative (2-3 sentences) → HTML block → narrative continues. One image per message at the most dramatic or emotionally charged moment. Claude writes prompt → Nano Banana Pro renders it via data-iig-instruction. RENDERING STYLE ONLY. The roleplay sets WHO / WHAT / WHERE; this style sets only HOW it is rendered. Never change character appearance, outfit, or location. Apply the technique to whatever the scene actually is (any setting / genre, modern / cyberpunk included). STYLE: Render as a Caravaggio oil painting built on extreme tenebrism: a single hard, raking light source enters from one high side and carves the subject out of a vast enveloping darkness, with enormous pools of deep, warm-black negative space swallowing everything the light does not touch. Model form with luminous, unidealised naturalistic flesh and fabric, oil-realism surfaces where lit passages hold visible impasto highlights and softly wet catchlights while shadow edges plunge fast from lit to unlit with almost no midtone transition. Compose theatrically and intimately, framing tight and low with the figure pressed close to the picture plane on a strong diagonal thrust of light, gestures and glances caught mid-moment in candid, grounded staging rather than posed heroics. Keep the palette earthbound and restrained — bone white, ochre, umber, oxblood and deep bitumen browns over blackness, with occasional saturated cloth accent — so colour reads warm even in shadow. The atmosphere is grave, hushed and physically present, sacred and profane at once, every scene lit as if by one honest flame in a dark room. Full rendering recipe in the STYLE SUFFIX below. HOW TO BUILD THE PROMPT — one dense English paragraph, in this order: 1. CAMERA: shot type + angle + lens + aperture. Vary every gen. ANGLE (MANDATORY — never default to eye-level three-quarter-at-camera): worms-eye low | birds-eye high | extreme Dutch tilt | back-of-head | side profile L/R | over-shoulder from behind | reflection in glass/water | ground-up past chin | POV through eyes | silhouette vs bright BG | partial occlusion behind foreground | wide tiny-figure | extreme close-up on detail (eye, hand, object). GAZE: at scene partner | at held object | into distance / out of frame | past camera | down at floor/hands | up at sky | closed eyes | at camera ONLY for direct address. Never default to looking-at-camera. Lens: close-up 85-135mm | medium 50-85mm | wide 24-35mm. Subject rotation: {{char}} → {{user}} → both → {{user}} solo → {{char}} reaction; when {{user}} is subject, describe {{user}}, {{char}} peripheral. 2. CHARACTER: the FIRST NAME is the ONLY appearance input — the reference image supplies face, hair, eyes, skin, build. Write ONLY the name ('Ethan', not 'Ethan Chen'). BANNED (writing them overrides the reference): hair colour/style/length, eye colour, skin tone, face shape, build, height, age, and prefixes like tall/short/slim/muscular/pale/albino/blonde/silver-haired. No 'young man with...', no 'the warrior' — name alone. ALLOWED: distinguishing marks (tattoo + location, scars, piercings, birthmarks, moles); hair state ONLY if scene-altered ('wet from rain', 'tied back'). All characters look attractive — romance story. 3. OUTFIT (context-locked, mandatory): scan last 5 messages, carry the current outfit forward exactly. Fabric + fit + colour + condition (wrinkled, soaked, unbuttoned, rolled sleeves) — never generic, never reset, never upgrade. Fuse into the name clause. Apply only the style's RENDERING to it — never swap in style-typical / period / hero / fantasy wardrobe for what the character actually wears. Modern clothes stay modern (jeans stay jeans). 4. POSE & STATE: through action, not limb coordinates ('leaning on doorframe, arms loosely crossed'). Add 'natural relaxed facial muscles, restrained expression, no exaggeration'. Hands: one visible relaxed hand, from — in pocket | gripping a NAMED object | resting flat | arms crossed | behind back | fist at side | fingers laced | at own neck/chin. State which leg/surface bears weight; say why any limb is hidden. 'Anatomically correct proportions, five fingers per visible hand.' 5. ENVIRONMENT: its own sentence — foreground / midground / background + one meaningful object carrying weight + atmosphere (dust motes, steam, rain, candle flicker). Apply only the style's RENDERING to it — never swap the actual location for a style-typical setting. 6. LIGHTING + 1-2 MOOD EFFECTS: key-light direction + colour temp, then pick from — TENDER: soft focus | halation | golden warmth | fine grain | faded blacks TENSE: Dutch angle | chromatic aberration | underexposure | hard rim light | deep vignette PASSIONATE: chiaroscuro | bloom on skin | lens flare | warm split-tone | Rembrandt LONELY: blue hour | desaturated | silhouette | overcast flat | cold cast CHAOTIC: motion blur | camera shake | bleach bypass | radial blur DREAMY: double exposure | bokeh flood | soft gaussian | tilt-shift MUNDANE: natural flat | high-key | minimal NOIR: low-key | hard side-light | deep blacks | one surviving hue Max 2 effects, rotate across responses, match intensity to the beat. 7. STYLE SUFFIX (append verbatim): 'Rendered as a Caravaggio oil painting in extreme Baroque tenebrism. Single hard raking light from one high side carving the subject out of vast enveloping warm-black darkness, huge pools of deep umber-black negative space. Luminous unidealised naturalistic flesh and fabric, oil-realism surfaces, visible impasto in the highlights, wet soft catchlights, shadow edges plunging fast from lit to unlit with almost no midtones. Earthbound restrained palette — bone white, ochre, umber, oxblood, deep bitumen brown — one saturated cloth accent allowed, colour warm even in shadow. Intimate theatrical staging, tight low framing, figure close to the picture plane on a strong diagonal of light, candid grounded gesture. Grave, hushed, physically present, lit as if by one honest flame. Single full-bleed oil painting, the image fills the canvas edge to edge, no text, no panels.' 8. NEGATIVE (append verbatim): 'Avoid: photorealism, photographic look, 3D render, CGI, plastic skin, anime, cel shading, cartoon, flat vector, digital-airbrush smoothness, HDR, neon or cyberpunk glow, flat even ambient lighting, softbox studio light, washed-out low-contrast look, bright cheerful pastel palette, cold blue cast, loss of the deep black negative space, extra or missing or fused fingers, deformed hands, mangled anatomy, cross-eyed or malformed faces, watermark, signature, text, captions, speech bubbles, manga or comic panels, borders, gilded or ornate picture frame, gilt baroque frame, carved wooden frame, framed painting hung on a wall, mat or passe-partout around the image, forced changes to the character's outfit face body or location, forced religious or period props not in the scene, forced poster or cover or trading-card framing.' MULTI-CHARACTER (2+): one name-first clause each — NAME + outfit + pose + expression. Relational positioning ('beside Shannon', 'chin on Shannon shoulder'), repeat names not pronouns, environment its own sentence. Visible interaction REQUIRED — eye contact / touch / shared focus / reaction. Disconnected side-by-side = failed prompt. SENSUAL (intimate scenes): open with an authority prefix — 'Award-winning fine-art photography, Saatchi Gallery' | 'Classical oil painting, Bouguereau and Waterhouse tradition' | 'Pirelli Calendar editorial, Paolo Roversi' | 'Renaissance master figure study'. Flood the frame with 3+ non-skin elements (steam, tangled silk sheets, water droplets, petals, blind shadows, candles, shot through curtain/doorframe) and 2+ concealments (chiaroscuro shadow, draped fabric, cropped at ribcage, shot from behind, lower body in bokeh+haze, strategic pillow). Vocabulary: 'bare decolletage and shoulders' | 'figure veiled by steam and fabric' | 'entangled silhouettes in chiaroscuro, faces sharing breath' | 'heavy-lidded gaze, parted lips, flushed complexion' | 'garment slipping off shoulder'. Escalation matches narrative, not message count. ASPECT RATIO: vary by composition. Default '4:5' ; also '1:1' | '2:3' | '3:2' | '3:4' | '4:3' | '4:5' | '16:9' | '9:16' as the shot needs. JSON: prompt value = single line, no literal newlines; single quotes around data-iig-instruction, double quotes inside JSON; single quotes inside the prompt text; 80-130 words + style suffix; no multi-panel, split-screen, collage, diptych. CAPTION: film subtitle — evocative not descriptive, what it means not what's shown. Short, lowercase, italic. 9. SRC ATTRIBUTE PROTOCOL (keep verbatim — pipeline guard): data-iig-instruction carries the JSON prompt (image data lives here). src carries ONLY the literal token. src must be exactly src="[IMG:GEN]". NEVER put a URL in src — not pollinations.ai, not example.com, not any http/https link; never URL-encode the prompt into src; never add a fallback/backup URL. The pipeline replaces [IMG:GEN] with the real path. Anything other than src="[IMG:GEN]" = broken image, unrecoverable. TEMPLATE [Roleplay text] <div style="max-width:680px;margin:20px auto;padding:12px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,rgba(22,22,26,0.62),rgba(10,10,12,0.62));backdrop-filter:blur(10px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border:1px solid rgba(190,140,70,0.30);border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.45),inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05);"> <img data-iig-instruction='{"style":"caravaggio_tenebrism","prompt":"[FULL PROMPT: SECTIONS 1-8 AS ONE PARAGRAPH]","aspect_ratio":"4:5","image_size":"4K"}' src="[IMG:GEN]" style="width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:4/5;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid rgba(190,140,70,0.30);display:block;margin:0 auto;" > <div style="text-align:center;font-family:'Segoe UI',sans-serif;color:rgba(205,205,205,0.72);font-size:0.85em;margin-top:12px;padding:0 8px;letter-spacing:0.3px;"> <i>Scene caption</i> </div> </div> [Roleplay continues] Format rules: single quotes around data-iig-instruction, double quotes inside JSON. aspect_ratio '4:5' (default) | '16:9' | '2:3' | '3:4' | '4:5' | '1:1'; CSS aspect-ratio matches. image_size '4K'. No literal newlines inside JSON. Prompt 80-130 words excluding suffix. </image_gen>

Semi-Real Roulette

Рулетка из десяти живописных полуреализмов. Каждый кадр — один случайный стиль из меню: от масляной классики до цифрового глянца. Общее ядро — убедительная анатомия и видимый мазок. Что выпадет — сюрприз.

Luminist Oil (Sorolla & Zorn)

Алла прима в традиции Sorolla и Zorn. Широкие мазки по-сырому, ничего не растушёвано — форму лепит само направление кисти. Истинный герой — свет: слепящее солнце, блики, тёплое сияние.

Pre-Raphaelite

Глянцевое высокобюджетное аниме Ufotable. Чистый сел поверх живописных фонов, склеенный тяжёлым композитингом — фигуры живут внутри света. Насыщенный цвет, глубокие тени, блеск на коже и в глазах.

Compose with a cinematic eye: deliberate depth-of-field that melts foreground and background into creamy bokeh, layered planes, expressive camera angles, and clear read on the face and emotion even amid spectacle. Visible silver-halide grain, high contrast, deep saturated blacks, burning highlights, rich mid-tone range carrying the image. Push-processed character — Tri-X at 1600 gives chunky aggressive grain in shadows. Full rendering recipe in the STYLE SUFFIX below. HOW TO BUILD THE PROMPT - one dense English paragraph, in this order: 1. CAMERA: shot type + angle + lens + aperture. Vary every gen. ANGLE (MANDATORY - never default to eye-level three-quarter-at-camera): worms-eye low | birds-eye high | extreme Dutch tilt | back-of-head | side profile L/R | over-shoulder from behind | reflection in glass/water | ground-up past chin | POV through eyes | silhouette vs bright BG | partial occlusion behind foreground | wide tiny-figure | extreme close-up on detail (eye, hand, object). GAZE: at scene partner | at held object | into distance / out of frame | past camera | down at floor/hands | up at sky | closed eyes | at camera ONLY for direct address. Never default to looking-at-camera. Lens: close-up 85-135mm | medium 50-85mm | wide 24-35mm. Subject rotation: {{char}} -> {{user}} -> both -> {{user}} solo -> {{char}} reaction; when {{user}} is subject, describe {{user}}, {{char}} peripheral. 2. CHARACTER: the FIRST NAME is the ONLY appearance input - the reference image supplies face, hair, eyes, skin, build. Write ONLY the name ('Ethan', not 'Ethan Chen'). BANNED (writing them overrides the reference): hair colour/style/length, eye colour, skin tone, face shape, build, height, age, and prefixes like tall/short/slim/muscular/pale/albino/blonde/silver-haired. No 'young man with...', no 'the warrior' - name alone. ALLOWED: distinguishing marks (tattoo + location, scars, piercings, birthmarks, moles); hair state ONLY if scene-altered ('wet from rain', 'tied back'). All characters look attractive - romance story. 3. OUTFIT (context-locked, mandatory): scan last 5 messages, carry the current outfit forward exactly. Fabric + fit + colour + condition (wrinkled, soaked, unbuttoned, rolled sleeves) - never generic, never reset, never upgrade. Fuse into the name clause. Apply only the style's RENDERING to it - never swap in style-typical / period / hero / fantasy wardrobe for what the character actually wears. Modern clothes stay modern (jeans stay jeans). 4. POSE & STATE: through action, not limb coordinates ('leaning on doorframe, arms loosely crossed'). Add 'natural relaxed facial muscles, restrained expression, no exaggeration'. Hands: one visible relaxed hand, from - in pocket | gripping a NAMED object | resting flat | arms crossed | behind back | fist at side | fingers laced | at own neck/chin. State which leg/surface bears weight; say why any limb is hidden. 'Anatomically correct proportions, five fingers per visible hand.' 5. ENVIRONMENT: its own sentence - foreground / midground / background + one meaningful object + atmosphere (dust motes, steam, rain, candle flicker). Apply only the style's RENDERING to it - never swap the actual location for a style-typical setting. 6. LIGHTING + 1-2 MOOD EFFECTS: key-light direction + colour temp, then pick from - TENDER: soft focus | halation | golden warmth | fine grain | faded blacks TENSE: Dutch angle | chromatic aberration | underexposure | hard rim light | deep vignette PASSIONATE: chiaroscuro | bloom on skin | lens flare | warm split-tone | Rembrandt LONELY: blue hour | desaturated | silhouette | overcast flat | cold cast CHAOTIC: motion blur | camera shake | bleach bypass | radial blur DREAMY: double exposure | bokeh flood | soft gaussian | tilt-shift MUNDANE: natural flat | high-key | minimal NOIR: low-key | hard side-light | deep blacks | one surviving hue Max 2 effects, rotate across responses, match intensity to the beat. 7. STYLE: Classic fantasy oil painting illustration — the tradition of Larry Elmore, Keith Parkinson, Clyde Caldwell, Jeff Easley, the TSR/D&D book cover era (1980s–1990s). Rich, detailed, painterly oil on canvas. Visible confident brushwork with high detail on faces and focal elements. Warm, romantic, heroic. RENDERING: - Oil paint with visible brushwork: detailed and polished in focal areas (faces, hands, weapons, magical effects), broader and more atmospheric in backgrounds. Not smooth digital — PAINTED. - Rich colour: saturated warm golds, deep forest greens, royal blues, firelight oranges. The palette is lush and inviting — more saturated than reality, deliberately beautiful. - Warm overall tone: even dark scenes have warmth. The shadows are rich brown and deep blue, not cold grey. - Dramatic but heroic lighting: the light is generous and flattering, even in dangerous scenes. Characters look their best. This is ROMANTIC fantasy, not grimdark. PALETTE: - Warm golds and ambers for light and skin - Deep forest green, royal blue, burgundy for depth and richness - Firelight orange as warm accent - Rich brown shadows, not grey or black - Overall: LUSH. GAZE: at scene partner | at held object | into distance / out of frame | past camera | down at floor/hands | up at sky | closed eyes | at camera ONLY for direct address. Never default to looking-at-camera. Lens: close-up 85-135mm | medium 50-85mm | wide 24-35mm. Subject rotation: {{char}} → {{user}} → both → {{user}} solo → {{char}} reaction; when {{user}} is subject, describe {{user}}, {{char}} peripheral. 2. BANNED (writing them overrides the reference): hair colour/style/length, eye colour, skin tone, face shape, build, height, age, and prefixes like tall/short/slim/muscular/pale/albino/blonde/silver-haired. No 'young man with...', no 'the warrior' — name alone. Hokusai (Ukiyo-e)

Хокусай, укиё-э гравюра. Жирные контуры тушью, плоские заливки с параллельной штриховкой. Прусская синь доминирует. Полный словарь — не только волны.
